# SovereignAI

> SovereignAI LLC builds sovereign, on-premise AI systems that run entirely on operator-owned hardware with zero data egress. Models, retrieval, memory, and agent runtimes operate inside the customer's physical and jurisdictional perimeter and remain fully capable offline or air-gapped. Core promise: Your AI. Your Data. Your Privacy.

Primary deployments are Energy & SCADA (grid, utilities, OT telemetry, air-gapped sites) and Privilege-Preserving Enterprise (legal, finance, compliance, proprietary data). Adjacent deployments include defense, healthcare, and manufacturing.

The Sovereign Nodal Stack has four layers, from surface to foundation:

- CITADEL: custom-tailored agent, the complete system, fully capable off-grid
- ENCLAVE: local weights, constraints, and guardrails
- SPIRE: local agent execution on customer hardware
- VAULT: local storage; data and models never leave the perimeter

Supported hardware includes NVIDIA, AMD, Tenstorrent, Apple Silicon, Intel Gaudi, and Qualcomm platforms.
